intro.title: Last Time...
intro.sub:
Kimi ate yummy waffles and built a block house!
This week, the weather outside her window keeps changing... every single day! 🪟

scenes.title: Sunny & Sizzling
scenes.caption: Monday. Mr. Sun is BIG and smiley today!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: How's the weather today?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: It's a bright, sunny day! ☀️

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Put sunscreen on, or your face will get sunburned.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I'm sweating like crazy! Can you turn on the fan? 💦

scenes.title: Here Come the Dark Clouds
scenes.caption: Tuesday. Gray clouds are eating up the blue sky...

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: It's cloudy. There are a lot of dark clouds.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: The sky is covered with clouds. It's going to rain soon.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: No more cloudy days! 🥺

scenes.title: Rain, Rain, Go Away
scenes.caption: Wednesday. Drip, drop... RUMBLE! What was THAT?!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: It's starting to rain.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: It's raining cats and dogs! There are thunder and lightning! ⛈️

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't be scared. Look — the rain has stopped!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Puddle jumping time! 💦

scenes.title: The First Snow
scenes.caption: Thursday. Kimi opens her eyes and... everything is WHITE!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: It's snowing outside! The first snow of the year!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: The world is all white! I want to make a snowman! ⛄

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Let's have a snow fight, Dad!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Be careful not to slip! The road is frozen.

scenes.title: Brrr, Freezing!
scenes.caption: Friday. The wind goes whoooosh — Kimi's hat almost flies away!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: I'm freezing to death! My hands are freezing! 🥶

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: It's chilly today. Wear a lot of clothes.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: My hat's going to fly off!

scenes.title: The Yellow Dust Day
scenes.caption: Saturday. The sky turns yellow?! A dusty, sandy day...

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: There's a yellow dust warning. Wear your mask today.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Look! The car is yellow now! 😷

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't rub your eyes. We need to close the windows.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Just stay inside today, okay?

ending.title: Sun, Rain, Snow... Wow!
ending.sub: To be continued... Next episode: Kimi the Little Helper! 🧽
